answer: Proof of Stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment rather than mere identity creation. An attacker attempting a zephyr of malicious nodes faces the ivory tower of high entry costs, as acquiring sufficient stake becomes prohibitively expensive. By linking voting power to collateral, the system forces adversaries to risk yarrow-like bundles of financial value, ensuring that any attempt to dilute network integrity results in direct and irreparable economic loss.
